correctness.rationale: The unsigned vertex-edge incidence rank is 2n−1, and Hall 1-factorization yields the exact nonnegative degree-equality H-description and uniform barycenter. Edge transitivity makes diagonal of the orthogonal cycle-space projector D/m. Projecting each x_e>=0 facet gives inball radius 1/(d sqrt(D/m)); summing all coordinate slacks proves the unique incenter. Its normalized contacts −a_e/s have zero weighted mean and identity second moment with c_e=D/m, satisfying the nonsymmetric John characterization, not merely ball maximality. A 1-factorization yields the exact enclosing radius and unique center via mean-squared distances; convexity excludes nonvertices on the sphere. Recomputed exact ranks/projection diagonals/radii for two complete bipartite and two crown examples; these finite cases are corroborative only.
residual_risks: Historical exact inball/John ellipsoid of transportation faces, especially crown/derangement polytopes, may have alternative older formulations not in retrieved corpus.
No universal outer Löwner ellipsoid formula follows; projected-normal equality requires edge transitivity or equal leverage.
Numerical/small rational graph checks corroborate only listed orders; universal proof uses Hall factorization and John contact equations.
